title: PRD-01 Ancoats city line (2016-2022)
summary: Closed cost centre PRD-01 for the historical Ancoats city line (2016-2022) under owner DOKAFOR and unit NBC-MAN-01.
body:
Cost centre PRD-01 represents the historical Ancoats city line (2016-2022) under unit NBC-MAN-01 and owner DOKAFOR [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026, the cost centre is CLOSED, having ceased active operations on 2022-12-31 [^r1]. It remains recorded in the chart of cost centres for historical accounting and reporting continuity [^r1].

## Record

Cost centre PRD-01 was operated under business unit NBC-MAN-01 by cost centre owner DOKAFOR [^r1]. The line closed on 2022-12-31, and its status in the master data register is CLOSED [^r1].
